mechanism: For every original parent whose complete direct-consumer set contains only leaves, compute their AND Q. Submit original P, then promote the retained P value to Q and serve all its children contiguously. Q has no new SRAM address or global parent identity.
candidate_rules: Every direct consumer is a leaf
No subgroup selection, pairwise search, added cache or new parent assignment
baseline: Same original forest, same complete leaf-star service order, same retained parent and child working register. Ordinary forwarding and retained-parent SRAM reductions credited to both sides.
sample_status: Same already-inspected 192-tile cohort; exploratory, not a new blind test
counts: All parent child-list scans, leaf tests and mask-AND operations
Common parent-retention service opportunity separated from promotion
Original destinations and exact rational lane values
expected_stop: If complete-leaf-star common residual is absent or small, stop this variant rather than introduce subgroup search after seeing data.
